pretreatments.description: Biological pretreatment utilizing a core microbiome primarily composed of Clostridium, Lactobacillus, and Enterobacter species to hydrolyze xylan into volatile fatty acids (modeled as acetic acid).

Enzymatic pretreatment using a commercial enzyme cocktail (Cellulase 50XL) with 293 endoglucanase units per gram of bagasse working in a 50 mM citrate buffer at pH 6, releasing mainly glucose, galactose, arabinose, and other sugars.
Dilute acid pretreatment using 1.8 % HCl under soft operating conditions to solubilize xylan and partially cellulose while eliminating inhibitor generation.
Steam explosion pretreatment using high-temperature depressurization in a plug flow reactor coupled to a flask tank to solubilize xylan, producing a mixture of sugars and acetic acid.
